id: 21_Replace the Motherboard for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊接机更换主控板
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/21_Replace the Motherboard for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/21_Replace the Motherboard for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder/src.py

points.K6: 拔下主板插头，有胶先去胶
points.K7: 拆下固定螺丝，取出旧主板
points.K8: 装新主板，插头插回原位
points.S1: 先记录故障，不盲目换板
points.S2: 摘下戒指手表等金属饰品
points.S5: 试焊：防护眼镜按波长选

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台带脚轮的激光焊接机旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a blank gray wheeled handheld laser welding machine in a workshop and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光焊接机怎样更换主控板。
overlay: 激光焊接机更换主控板

shots.scene: 记录、拆卸、装回、清点、试焊五个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a notebook, an open machine cabinet, a circuit board, a tray of small screws, and laser safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 记录故障，规范拆装，清点零件，安全试焊。

shots.scene: 焊接机屏幕不亮，阿杰拿着一块新电路板就要换
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a new circuit board in front of a laser welding machine with a dark blank screen, eager to swap it in.
shots.narration: 焊接机开不了机，阿杰认定是主板坏了。

shots.scene: 老李摆摆手，指向空白的故障记录本
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer waves his hand gently and points at a blank fault logbook on the bench.
shots.narration: 老李说：先别急着换，故障记清楚了吗？

shots.scene: 小研在旁边点头，拿出笔准备记录
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student nods beside them and takes out a pen, ready to write in the logbook.
shots.narration: 换板之前，我们先把步骤和要点理一理。

shots.section_title: 先记录故障，不盲目换板
shots.scene: 欣欣指着空白记录本，旁边浮现报警灯和时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank logbook; an alarm light icon and a clock icon float beside it.
shots.narration: 先记下故障现象、报警提示和发生时间。
overlay: 先记录故障，不盲目换板

shots.section_title: 先记录故障，不盲目换板
shots.scene: 老李翻开空白说明书，对照着一张排查流程图
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens a blank service manual next to a simple flowchart made only of boxes and arrows.
shots.narration: 按说明书逐项排查，必要时联系厂家。

shots.section_title: 先记录故障，不盲目换板
shots.scene: 一堆被换下的零件旁有一个问号，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A pile of swapped-out parts with a big question mark above it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要凭猜测乱换件，原因要找准。

shots.section_title: 先记录故障，不盲目换板
shots.scene: 老李在空白派工单上签字，阿杰站在一旁看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer signs a blank work order while the young male student watches from the side.
shots.narration: 换板由授权维修人员按程序进行。

shots.scene: 台面上摆着两把十字螺丝刀、一把内六角扳手、一把镊子
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a workbench with two cross-head screwdrivers of different sizes, a hex wrench and a pair of tweezers neatly laid out. No people.
shots.narration: 先备齐工具：两把大小不同的十字螺丝刀，

shots.scene: 工具旁放着一块装在袋子里的新电路板
shots.prompt_en: A new circuit board in a sealed bag lies next to the tools on the workbench. No people.
shots.narration: 一把内六角扳手、一把镊子，还有新主板。

shots.section_title: 摘下戒指手表等金属饰品
shots.scene: 老李摘下戒指和手表，放进一个小盒子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer takes off his ring and wristwatch and puts them into a small box on the side table.
shots.narration: 动手前，摘下戒指、手表等金属饰品。
overlay: 摘下戒指手表等金属饰品

shots.section_title: 摘下戒指手表等金属饰品
shots.scene: 戴着金属手链的手伸向电路的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand wearing a metal bracelet reaching toward a circuit, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 金属饰品导电，碰到线路可能短路烫伤。

shots.section_title: 摘下戒指手表等金属饰品
shots.scene: 长袖口挽起，工牌塞进衣服里
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer rolls up loose sleeves and tucks his hanging badge lanyard into his shirt.
shots.narration: 宽松袖口和挂绳也要收好。

shots.scene: 老李按下焊接机开关，然后拔下电源插头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the laser welding machine and pulls the power plug out of the wall socket.
shots.narration: 第一步：关机，拔掉电源插头。

shots.scene: 老李把焊枪线、地线、气管等从机器上依次拔下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer disconnects all the cables and the gas hose from the back of the machine one by one.
shots.narration: 连在机器上的其他线缆，也全部拔下。

shots.scene: 老李蹲下，把机器底部的脚轮锁扣按下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer crouches and presses down the brake lever on a caster wheel under the machine.
shots.narration: 把机器底部四个脚轮全部锁住。

shots.scene: 四个脚轮图标都带锁，机器稳稳停在地上
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a wheeled machine with all four casters showing small lock symbols, standing still. No people.
shots.narration: 拆装时机器不会滑动，更安全。

shots.scene: 机器侧面，把手两端的螺丝被圆圈标出
shots.prompt_en: Side view of the laser welding machine with green circles marking the screws at both ends of the top handles. No people.
shots.narration: 用内六角扳手，松开前后把手的螺丝。

shots.scene: 老李把松开的把手取下，放在一旁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the loosened handle off the machine and places it on the bench.
shots.narration: 两个把手一共八颗螺丝，拆下放好。

shots.scene: 老李用小号十字螺丝刀拧下侧盖顶部的螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer uses a small cross-head screwdriver to remove a screw at the top of the left side cover.
shots.narration: 换小号十字螺丝刀，拆下左盖的螺丝。

shots.scene: 老李把左侧盖板向外取下，露出内部电路
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the left side cover away, revealing power modules, wiring and a circuit board inside.
shots.narration: 取下左侧盖板，就能看到主控板了。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在打开的机柜旁，手里端着一个分格零件盒
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the open machine cabinet holding a small compartment parts tray.
shots.narration: 机柜打开后，小零件最怕掉进去。

shots.scene: 一颗螺丝掉在两块电路板之间，闪出火花图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tiny screw lying between two circuit boards with a small spark symbol, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 螺丝卡在电路之间，通电就可能短路。

shots.scene: 拆下的螺丝按步骤放进零件盒的不同格子
shots.prompt_en: Removed screws are placed into different sections of the compartment tray, one section per step. No people.
shots.narration: 拆一步放一格，螺丝分开放好。

shots.scene: 老李用带磁性的螺丝刀吸住螺丝，慢慢取出
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts a screw out carefully with a magnetic-tip screwdriver, holding his other hand beneath it.
shots.narration: 取螺丝时手在下方护着，别让它掉落。

shots.section_title: 拔下主板插头，有胶先去胶
shots.scene: 老李捏住插头本体，把它从主板上拔下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer grips a connector body and pulls it straight out of the circuit board.
shots.narration: 依次拔下主板上的所有插头。
overlay: 拔下主板插头，有胶先去胶

shots.section_title: 拔下主板插头，有胶先去胶
shots.scene: 老李用镊子轻轻剥掉插头上的固定胶
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer uses tweezers to gently peel away a dab of glue holding a connector in place.
shots.narration: 插头上有固定胶的，先用镊子去胶。

shots.section_title: 拔下主板插头，有胶先去胶
shots.scene: 剥下的胶块被收进小袋子里
shots.prompt_en: Small pieces of removed glue are dropped into a little waste bag on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 去下的胶块收走，不留在机柜里。

shots.section_title: 拆下固定螺丝，取出旧主板
shots.scene: 主板特写，七个螺丝孔位被圆圈标出
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the circuit board inside the machine with seven green circles marking its mounting screws. No people.
shots.narration: 主板由七颗螺丝固定在机架上。
overlay: 拆下固定螺丝，取出旧主板

shots.section_title: 拆下固定螺丝，取出旧主板
shots.scene: 老李用大号十字螺丝刀逐颗拧下螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the board's mounting screws one by one with a larger cross-head screwdriver.
shots.narration: 用大号十字螺丝刀，逐颗拆下。

shots.section_title: 拆下固定螺丝，取出旧主板
shots.scene: 老李捏着旧主板边缘取出，放到一旁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds the old circuit board by its edges, lifts it out and sets it aside in a bag.
shots.narration: 取出旧主板，装袋放好。

shots.section_title: 装新主板，插头插回原位
shots.scene: 老李把新主板对准螺丝孔放好
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lines up the new circuit board with the mounting holes inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 新主板对准孔位，放回原来的位置。
overlay: 装新主板，插头插回原位

shots.section_title: 装新主板，插头插回原位
shots.scene: 老李拧上七颗螺丝固定新主板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer fastens the new board with its seven screws using the cross-head screwdriver.
shots.narration: 拧上七颗螺丝，固定牢靠。

shots.section_title: 装新主板，插头插回原位
shots.scene: 老李把插头逐个插回原来的插座
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer plugs each connector back into its original socket on the new board.
shots.narration: 插头逐个插回原位，插到底。

shots.scene: 老李把机器下方垂落的线缆理顺，收回机内
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer gathers the loose cables hanging below the open side and tucks them neatly inside.
shots.narration: 整理好左侧的线缆，收回机内。

shots.scene: 整齐的线束图标打勾，被盖板压住的线图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons side by side: a neat cable bundle with a green check mark, and a cable pinched under a cover edge with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 线缆不能被盖板压住。

shots.scene: 老李对照空白清单，清点零件盒里的螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer counts the screws in the compartment tray against a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 装盖之前，先清点螺丝和零件。

shots.scene: 老李用手电照着机柜内部仔细查看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer shines a flashlight into the open cabinet and looks carefully into every corner.
shots.narration: 用手电照一遍，机柜里没有遗留物。

shots.scene: 一把螺丝刀落在机柜里的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a screwdriver left inside a closed machine cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 工具也要点齐，一件都不能落下。

shots.scene: 盖板边缘的挂钩和机架上的销钉，用箭头对应
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of the side cover edge with three hooks and the machine frame with three pegs, arrows matching each hook to a peg. No people.
shots.narration: 左盖两侧有三个挂钩，对准三个销钉。

shots.scene: 老李把盖板推入机器，再拧紧顶部螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pushes the side cover into place and tightens the screw at its top.
shots.narration: 把盖板推进去，再拧紧螺丝固定。

shots.scene: 老李把把手放回原位，用内六角扳手拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer sets a handle back on top of the machine and tightens its screws with the hex wrench.
shots.narration: 最后装回把手，拧紧螺丝。

shots.scene: 老李走到另一侧，同样装好把手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks to the other side of the machine and fits the second handle the same way.
shots.narration: 另一侧也一样，四颗螺丝全部拧紧。

shots.section_title: 试焊：防护眼镜按波长选
shots.scene: 欣欣举起一副激光防护眼镜，镜腿上有空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a pair of laser safety goggles with a blank label on the temple.
shots.narration: 修好后要试焊，防护眼镜不能随便拿。
overlay: 试焊：防护眼镜按波长选

shots.section_title: 试焊：防护眼镜按波长选
shots.scene: 眼镜标签和焊接机铭牌之间用箭头连接，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: An arrow links a blank label on laser safety goggles to a blank rating plate on the welding machine, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 要和设备的激光波长相匹配。

shots.section_title: 试焊：防护眼镜按波长选
shots.scene: 墨镜和普通护目镜图标，都被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of ordinary sunglasses and clear safety glasses, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 墨镜、普通护目镜，挡不住这种激光。

shots.section_title: 试焊：防护眼镜按波长选
shots.scene: 老李检查眼镜镜片有没有划痕裂纹
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tilts the laser safety goggles under the light and checks the lenses for scratches or cracks.
shots.narration: 戴前检查镜片，有划痕裂纹就更换。

shots.section_title: 试焊：防护眼镜按波长选
shots.scene: 欣欣指着一本封面有激光标志的空白小册子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank booklet with a laser warning pictogram on the cover.
shots.narration: 选用要求以现行国家标准为准。

shots.section_title: 试焊：防护眼镜按波长选
shots.scene: 老李戴好眼镜在围挡内试焊，阿杰站在围挡外
shots.prompt_en: Wearing laser safety goggles, the facility engineer test-welds inside an opaque curtained area while the young male student waits outside.
shots.narration: 试焊在围挡内进行，无关人员离开。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊接机旁，身后浮现几个步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the closed laser welding machine with a row of step icons floating behind: a notebook, a ring crossed out, a parts tray and goggles.
shots.narration: 记故障，摘饰品，管好螺丝，戴对眼镜。

shots.scene: 阿杰把新电路板交回老李，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands the spare circuit board back to the facility engineer and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰明白了：换板不是拆了就换。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in the workshop.
shots.narration: 维修讲规范，用机才安心。下次见！
